portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: /Planning/Display?applicationNumber= detail pages and document rows keyed by module=PLA, recordNumber, planID and imageID, the Atrium document model. The markup is a newer ASP.NET Core generation (CfDJ8 antiforgery token, /js/Documents.js) without the /Content/def/ assets Recipe A lists.

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: PYY/SNNNN/TYPE. The S marks South Oxfordshire; the Vale of White Horse uses V in the same place on its own register.

quirks.summary: Every page first redirects to /Disclaimer?returnURL=...; accepting is a form POST to /Disclaimer/AcceptDisclaimer with returnURL and the page's __RequestVerificationToken.
quirks.detail: Accepting sets a DisclaimerAccepted cookie. Keep one cookie jar for the rest of the run.
quirks.workaround: POST the disclaimer form once with the token from the disclaimer page, then carry the jar.

quirks.summary: The search form is a 'recaptcha-form' that loads Google reCAPTCHA Enterprise, so the register search was not scripted.
quirks.detail: The detail page is a plain GET on the human reference, so a known reference does not need the search.
quirks.workaround: Go straight to /Planning/Display?applicationNumber=<url-encoded REF>. For discovery by address, use the register in a browser.

quirks.summary: There are no /Document/Download links: each document row is a 'View' button, and the file comes from POST /Document/GetFileBinary as a JSON string of base64.
quirks.detail: Form fields: module (data-module), recordNumber (data-recordNumber), planID and imageID (the row's data-planID and data-imageID as integers) and isPlan (the row's data-storedInDatabase, lower-cased). The response is application/json whose body is one quoted base64 string; decode it before checking magic bytes. A multi-select zip exists at POST /Document/DownloadSelected (JSON body, RequestVerificationToken header).
quirks.workaround: Scrape the tr.grid-dataRow data attributes from the detail page, POST GetFileBinary per row, JSON-decode then base64-decode, and check %PDF- on the decoded bytes. A grep for /Document/Download finds nothing and reads as 'no documents'.

pacing.note: Seven requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge. The host is behind Cloudflare (passive at the time).

browser_route.note: URL-encode the reference (/ as %2F). Accept the disclaimer when asked.

verification.note: Portal resolved from PlanIt's areas record; a separate host from the Vale of White Horse register but the same product and build. Disclaimer accepted by its form POST; the search form carries reCAPTCHA and was not used. Reference P26/S4200/TCA from PlanIt's applics records -> detail page with 5 document rows (4 View buttons; PlanIt n_documents 5) -> POST Document/GetFileBinary for one row -> base64 JSON decoded to a 408,539-byte JPEG (JFIF magic bytes), an image rather than an error page. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id.
